_comment: THE BOUNDED SHORT FINAL-CELL PROBE. Keys are TrainConfig field names; keys starting with '_' are comments (JSON has none). Load with: python -m match_aou.rl.training.graph_train --config configs/graph_train/final_cell_probe.json
_scope: A SHORT PROBE, NOT A BASELINE. 2 iterations x 4 training episodes, plus one pre_update and one post_update held-out round of 4 matched pairs each. It exists to measure how the merged fuel-damage cell behaves; a long baseline is a separately authorized task and is deliberately NOT presettable here.
_schedule: Bounded: 8 scheduled training episodes total. Every scheduled seed is attempted at most once (skip_and_account_v1) -- a failure is recorded, never retried or replaced.
_evaluation: eval_every=2 with n_iterations=2 gives exactly two rounds: the pre_update measurement of the untrained policy (updates_completed=0) and one post_update round after both updates. eval_base_seed sits far beyond the training band, so the held-out seeds are never trained on.
_cell: The final Phase-A scenario cell, unchanged: 3 agents, 3 known + 3 route-relative hidden airbase targets (6 emitted), 200 km launch-to-target floor, 100 km known-target separation, no SAMs.
_difficulty: FD-BASELINE-v1, exactly as merged on main. The seeded mixture makes the condition a deterministic function of the episode seed; evaluation ignores the mode and forces both members of each matched pair. aircraft_penalty_coeff is the death penalty c that graph_reward already accepted -- the reward FORMULA is unchanged.
_artifacts: ON for this probe: each scheduled attempt keeps its known-only scenario, its authoritative executed t=0 scenario, the BLADE playback and a manifest under <run_dir>/visual_artifacts/. Observation only -- nothing captured is read back, and artifact completeness is reported alongside the scientific denominators, never in place of one.
